PROFILE PHOTO
=============

Save your profile photo in this folder as:

    udhaya-nilavan.jpg

It is picked up automatically the next time the page loads. No code change needed.

Until that file exists, the hero shows a neutral monogram placeholder.
A certificate image is never used as the profile photo.

Recommended: portrait orientation, roughly 4:5, at least 800x1000px, under 4 MB.
Supported: .jpg (change the path in src/components/ui/ProfilePhoto.tsx for other formats).

You can also click the photo frame on the live site to try a photo. That version is
saved in your browser only and is not part of the project files.
